verdict.rationale: Cognee documents ingestion, retrieval, deletion (.forget), cloud push, and self-hosting, but nothing in the evidence describes an explicit 'export all data' feature or open-format data dump the user could take elsewhere. Deletion (.forget) removes data rather than exporting it, and cloud 'push' moves data to Cognee's own cloud rather than out. missing for 10: documented export/backup command, open-format (e.g., JSON/RDF/GraphML) data dump, and any independent confirmation users have exported and migrated data away from Cognee.
